title: On Fulfiling the promise to the letter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：fulfil　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fulfil 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the keeper ① fulfiled the promise to the letter in silence, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② fulfils the promise to the letter twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fulfil the promise to the letter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ fulfiled the promise to the letter before — a line in the register for March 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Fulfiling the promise to the letter in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fulfil every condition in the contract twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fulfil every condition in the contract at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ fulfils every condition in the contract in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ fulfiled the promise to the letter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fulfil the promise to the letter, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody fulfils the promise to the letter twice over again and somebody must fulfil the promise to the letter in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 完成（一般过去式 fulfiled the promise to the letter：1956 年饲养员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 完成（一般现在 fulfils the promise to the letter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 完成（不定式 to fulfil the promise to the letter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 完成（过去完成时 had fulfiled the promise to the letter：1950 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 完成（动名词 fulfiling the promise to the letter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 实现（fulfil every condition in the contract：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去实现合约里写的每一条都做到）
G. v. 实现（fulfil every condition in the contract：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 完成（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 fulfils every condition in the contract，而母亲又一次 fulfiled the promise to the letter）

answers.why: fulfil 意为“完成”，1956 年饲养员一言不发地完成一字不差地履践那个诺言，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 fulfiled。
fulfil 意为“完成”，自那以后饲养员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 fulfils。
fulfil 意为“完成”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯完成一字不差地履践那个诺言”，此处为不定式 to fulfil the promise to the letter。
fulfil 意为“完成”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1963 年之前就有人完成过，故用过去完成时 had fulfiled。
fulfil 意为“完成”，饲养员说“完成一字不差地履践那个诺言这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 fulfiling the promise to the letter 作主语。
fulfil 意为“实现”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去实现合约里写的每一条都做到”，should ever 之后用原形 fulfil every condition in the contract。
fulfil 意为“实现”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻实现合约里写的每一条都做到（fulfil every condition in the contract at once），以后再也不要提起。
fulfil 意为“完成”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例实现合约里写的每一条都做到，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 fulfils。
fulfil 意为“完成”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地完成一字不差地履践那个诺言，用一般过去式 fulfiled 叙述。
fulfil 意为“完成”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要完成一字不差地履践那个诺言，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fulfil 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the keeper fulfiled the promise to the letter in silence, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper fulfils the promise to the letter twice over whenever the zoo asks.
Fulfiling the promise to the letter in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fulfil every condition in the contract twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo fulfils every condition in the contract in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother fulfiled the promise to the letter again, and the zoo remembered that half.
